version.description: Concrete version resolved from node_modules (e.g. '19.2.4'). Identifies the package input only — it does not imply identical source text across MFEs, since each MFE builds its own chunk. Cross-MFE reuse of that chunk's text is governed by 'contentHash', not by 'version' alone.

chunkPath.description: The standalone ESM file for this dependency: an http(s) URL, or a path relative to metaData.publicPath that stays under it (e.g. 'shared/react.js'). The canonical rules, including the values that fail the load, are defined by @gears-frontx/mfes: MfManifestShared.chunkPath and the mfe-loading FEATURE (cpt-frontx-algo-mfe-loading-manifest-discovery, inst-md-resolve-chunk-path).

unwrapKey.description: Named export key to unwrap the module from the chunk. Null when the chunk exports the module directly.

contentHash.description: Optional sha256 hex digest (64 lowercase hex characters) of this entry's emitted chunk, published by the producing build. Identifies the producing build so the handler's cross-MFE shared-dep source-text cache can key reuse on it rather than on name+version alone. Absent when the producer has not adopted content hashing.
